patch_description:
The current program has 3 ZZZ gates but prior versions with 2 ZZZ gates achieved better combined score (0.56 vs 0.54). The generalization gap increased from 0.08 to 0.10, indicating overfitting. Following the recommendation, I will:

1. Remove the third ZZZ gate on [2,3,7] 
2. Replace the second ZZZ gate's qubits from [1,5,6] to [2,5,8] to explore alternative three-qubit correlations

This maintains the dual-ZZZ mid-layer structure shown to control overfitting while testing a different coupling pattern. The [2,5,8] triplet captures interactions across different regions of the qubit register compared to [1,5,6], potentially capturing complementary features while reducing model complexity.
